learning_objective: 🎯 Step onto the stage and discover how actors, directors, and the backstage crew work together to create the magic of theatre!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Theatre is a special place where stories come alive right in front of your eyes! The stage is the raised platform where actors perform, and the audience sits in the dark to watch the magic unfold.
An actor never works alone! The director guides the story, makeup artists prepare the faces, and lighting crews make sure everything looks perfect. Theatre is one giant team effort.
A prop is any object an actor holds, like a magic wand or an umbrella. Along with costumes, props help the audience believe the actor is really a wizard, a king, or a detective!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Mystery Prop Play
fun_activity.instructions: Find three random, safe objects in your house (like a spoon, a hat, and a pillow). Create a 2-minute funny play using all three items as your stage props and perform it for your family!

quick_recap: ⭐ Theatre is live art where actors perform stories on a stage for an audience.
⭐ A successful play requires amazing teamwork between actors and backstage crew.
⭐ Props are objects that actors handle on stage to make the story feel real.
⭐ Dialogues are the written words that actors speak to each other during the play.
